562 x 385 mm (17 x 25")
Pinwheels and Ribbons Cole is a simple piece that lets you knit one pinwheel and one ribbon at a time; You knit some pins straight, and then knit some pins backwards to get ribs. To create the seamless, tensioned tubular shape of the cowl without a joining seam, you join a pinwheel row to a ribbon row. It is all totally "natural" in every way, and a pleasure to knit. You can make either three or four rows of ribbon for a little teepee, or a long, more streamlined "drape" (a pinwheel row makes the fabric wider, while a ribbon row keeps it from folding in, that's why you want fewer ribbon rows). When I was first developing this pattern, I worked a bunch of swatches just for fun, and the result is some really pretty pinwheel and ribbon "curtains", so that's how it is.
